constraints: Requires either one defined sAtreeZero or exactly one local STT_OBJECT in .sdata2 with size 4 and zero bytes; ambiguous or missing candidates fail closed.
Requires natreelists, atree_handles, atree_scroll, and whichatree to exist as defined local symbols before promotion and as global symbols after promotion.
Only renames or promotes existing ELF symbols; it does not change code, data, relocations, or addresses.
name: atree-exports
purpose: Target-independent, fail-closed ELF symbol visibility restoration for atree's retail cross-TU interface without changing section, relocation, or address bytes.
usage: Matching build: run after WebFrank on atree.o to name its existing anonymous zero datum sAtreeZero and promote the four atree state symbols plus sAtreeZero to global binding.
Non-matching build: run without WebFrank so mod builds retain the same cross-TU interface while all target-dependent instruction postprocessing remains bypassed.
